text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Nothin' beats a hot bath at the
local
bathhouse after workin' up a good
sweat! Pure
heaven!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What's the deal?! This water's lukewarm!

text_block_list.name: Bathhouse Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, Inari. Looks like the
darn thing is
busted. We've got the
repair people comin'
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gah! I'd rather jump in an ice-cold tub!
The gods
sure are merciless.
